title: 재외공관 무관주재령 / queue:ADDENDUM:24413:20130323:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of National Defense and Its Affiliated Agencies) <No. 24413, March 23, 2013>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Article 2 Omitted.

Article 3 (Amendment of Other Statutes or Regulations) (1) through (24) Omitted.

(25) Part of the Decree on Military Attachés Stationed at Diplomatic Missions Abroad shall be amended as follows:

In the provisos to Articles 4 and 8, and in Article 10 (1) and (2), "Minister of Foreign Affairs and Trade" shall be replaced with "Minister of Foreign Affairs" in each case.

(26) through (32) Omitted.
